stem:
Meena's younger brother in their home in Nagpur has chickenpox, which spreads when the pathogen passes from an infected person to others through close contact and through contaminated articles like shared towels and bedding.
Which single step best prevents the disease from spreading to the rest of the family?

options.text: Keep the brother's towels, bedsheets and utensils separate and wash hands after touching them
Make sure everyone in the house drinks boiled water at every meal
Spray the rooms every evening to kill mosquitoes
Give the whole family vitamin tablets so they do not fall ill

teacher.key_rationale: Chickenpox spreads by direct contact with the patient and indirect contact via contaminated towels, bedding and utensils, so separating these articles and handwashing blocks the actual transmission route (A). Boiled water (B) addresses water-borne diseases, mosquito control (C) addresses vector-borne diseases, and vitamins (D) do not block any transmission route.
